title.narrative: Project Support to Kyiv School Economics 2025
Projektstöd till Kyiv School of Economics 2025

description.narrative: Projektet bidrar till Kyiv School of Economics arbete med att främja Ukrainas integration i Europeiska unionen genom att skapa ett nytt center för EU-närmandefrågor. Centret, ”The Swedish Center for European Future at KSE University”, ska bland annat tillhandahålla utbildning och forskning, liksom bredare kunskapshöjande insatser, kopplade till EU-integrationen.

The project contributes to the Kyiv School of Economics' work of promoting Ukraine's integration into the European Union by creating a new center for EU rapprochement. The center, called ”The Swedish Center for European Future at KSE University”, will provide education and research, as well as broader knowledge-raising efforts, linked to EU integration.
